title: Vantage project (project.json inside a .vantage file), format version 1
description: A .vantage file is a ZIP archive: project.json (this schema), mesh.npz (the vehicle body: vertices float32 (V,3) metres in the vehicle frame, faces int32 (F,3), face_part int32 (F,), face_zone int16 (F,)) and optionally thumb.png. Vehicle frame: ISO 8855, x forward, y left, z up, metres, origin at the rear-axle centre on the ground. Orientations: intrinsic Z-Y-X yaw, pitch, roll in degrees, pitch positive DOWN, the body's optical axis along +x. docs/project-format.md explains every part. The schema is strict (unknown keys are errors) so that it documents every field Vantage writes; Vantage's own reader is tolerant: it ignores unknown keys and fills missing ones with defaults.

format.description: Marks the file as a Vantage project.

version.description: Format version; 1 since Vantage 0.1. New fields are added without a new version (older readers ignore them, newer ones fill them in).

created.description: When the project was created, seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

saved_at.description: When the file was saved, seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

modules.description: Camera modules by id: the built-in library and any edited or custom ones (a saved entry wins over the built-in one of the same id).

sensor_models.description: Lidar, radar, GNSS antenna and IMU models by id (as modules).

variants.description: Rig layouts on the vehicle: each a set of cameras and sensors.

active.description: uid of the variant shown when the project opens.

obstacles.description: Poles and other standing objects around the vehicle (coverage checks).

rig.description: Solids of the data-collection rig on the vehicle (roof rack, mast, crossbar, enclosure): they block views like the body and cameras can be placed on them.

frame.description: Display and default export frame (origin), all with ISO 8855 axes.

custom_origin.description: Origin of the 'custom' frame in the vehicle frame, metres.

units.description: Display length unit (the file always stores metres).

streams.description: Live stream source per camera tag: RTSP/HTTP URL (never with a password: passwords live in the user's private store), a device, a file or 'synthetic'.

log.description: The last 400 entries of the project's history: [time (s since 1970 UTC), kind, text].

uid.description: A random identity (10 hexadecimal digits) other entries refer to; it carries no meaning.

vehicle.description: The vehicle the rig is planned on. Its body triangles are in mesh.npz.

spec_name.description: Model name as shown (e.g. 'Tata Tigor EV sedan').

source.description: Where the body came from: the imported file's path on the computer it was imported on, or 'template:<key>'.

template.description: Template key when generated (tigor, sedan, hatchback, suv, van, truck), else empty.

import_units.description: Length unit of the imported model.

occluder_target.description: Triangles the body is simplified to for occlusion.

wheel_centres.description: Wheel centres FL, FR, RL, RR in the vehicle frame, metres.

spec.description: Datasheet dimensions in metres (Length, Width, Height, Wheelbase, Ground clearance, …).

landmarks.description: Named points on the body in the vehicle frame, metres.

imported_tris.description: Triangles of the model as imported.

parts.description: Body parts, indexed by mesh.npz face_part.

zones.description: Mount zones, indexed by mesh.npz face_zone (-1 = none).

material.description: Material name imported with the model ('rig' for rig parts).

role.description: Whether the part blocks views and can carry a camera.

surface.description: Surface material class (core.materials); absent = from the role and name.

surface_mm.description: Its thickness, mm; absent = the class's typical one.

auto.description: Made by Vantage (from the parts) rather than painted by the user.

module.description: A camera module. Figures are datasheet values; 'note' gives the source.

lens.description: A lens: its projection r(θ) maps the angle off the optical axis to the image height.

module_id.description: Module it was characterised on (empty: any).

sheet_fov.description: Datasheet field of view H, V, D, degrees (0: unknown).

max_half_deg.description: Image-circle half angle, degrees (0: from the diagonal FOV).

pp_offset_px.description: Principal point offset from the sensor centre, pixels.

measured.description: Measured [θ degrees, image height mm] samples the model was fitted to.

sensor_model.description: A lidar, radar, GNSS antenna or IMU product or typical class. Angles in degrees, ranges in metres.

beams.description: Measured beam elevations, degrees (override the even v_min..v_max spread).

range_m.description: Lidar: on a 10 % target; radar: on a car (10 m²).

zones.description: Radar zones: [range m, azimuth half-angle °, elevation half-angle °].

seams.description: Manual stitching seams: 'uidA|uidB' (two cameras) → azimuth in degrees about the body centre, counter-clockwise from +x.

camera.description: A camera: its position is the optical centre in the vehicle frame, metres; yaw, pitch (positive down) and roll in degrees turn the body's +x optical axis.

tag.description: Short name (F, R, ML, …), unique in the variant.

standoff_mm.description: Optical centre off the surface, mm.

link_uid.description: uid of the mirrored partner camera (empty: none).

unit_calibration.description: The camera's own lens calibration (empty: the library lens). OpenCV pixel coordinates (pixel centres on integers), Kannala–Brandt / OpenCV fisheye model; it overrides the lens model.

sensor.description: A lidar, radar, GNSS antenna or IMU: the position is its optical centre (a GNSS antenna's phase centre, an IMU's axis origin) in the vehicle frame, metres; yaw, pitch (positive down), roll in degrees.

phase_deg.description: Spinning lidar: the sensor-frame azimuth it faces at the top of each sync period.

roi.description: The ground region of interest the coverage figures are computed on.

distance.description: Offset mode: metres beyond the body.

polygon.description: Polygon mode: ground points [x, y], metres.

analysis.description: Analysis settings. Every study keeps its own settings in a slot here (empty = its defaults); each module's settings class documents and clamps its fields.

heatmap.description: Heat map shown in the views.

load_cases.description: [name, front axle drop mm, rear axle drop mm].

drivelog.description: The drive-log check (core/drivelog.py DriveLogSettings): path, variant_uid, camera_stamp, lidar_stamp, frames_per_camera, tolerance_deg, search_deg, drop_factor, freeze_frames, sync_tol_ms, sync_sweeps, mappings {bag path: {topic: tag}}.

freeze_frames.description: Repeats of one image in a row (identical content) that make a camera frozen, a fault; fewer are a warning. Default 3.

sim.description: The CARLA run (core/simrig.py SimSettings): town, weather, duration_s, traffic, walkers, seed, vehicle, camera_rate, image_scale, face_oversample, undistort, jpeg_quality, exposure, exposure_ev, keyframe_hz, channel_names, nuscenes, rosbag, lidar_noise_cm, drop_self_hits, max_lidar_channels, radar_points, tick_hz, min_tick_hz, max_tick_hz, warmup_s, quality, memory_gb, port, tm_port, timeout_s, ground_truth {semantic, instance, range, lidar_labels}, faults [{tag, kind, ...}], scenario {name, params}, actors [{id, kind, pose}], spawn_point.

experiments.description: A designed experiment (core/experiments.py ExperimentSettings): name, variant, factors, responses, design, samples, sobol_n, morris_r, levels, morris_levels, seed, bootstrap, confidence, workers.

detection.description: Detection quality per rig (core/detection_eval.py DetectionSettings): recordings, model, input_px, max_input_px, keep_score, nms_iou, max_dets, fuse_riders, backend, threads, score, iou, iou_small, small_px, min_px, min_pixels, max_occluded, max_truncated, range_edges, height_edges, classes, cameras, frame_step, views, view_fov_deg, view_pitch_deg, view_yaws, view_width, view_aspect, bootstrap, block_s, confidence, seed, min_gt, cache.

campaign.description: A simulation campaign (core/simcampaign.py CampaignSettings): name, template, variants, seeds, weathers, scenarios, fault_sets [{kind, tags, axes, magnitudes, signs}], clean, multiplex, base, evaluators, asbuilt_on, drivelog, health, detection, target, confidence, server, out_dir, max_drives.

critical_carla.description: Critical targets as CARLA scenes (core/critical_carla.py CriticalCarlaSettings): town, weather, spawn_points, seed, duration_s, image_scale, frames, group, vehicle, actors {target uid: auto | standin | none | blueprint:<id>}.

target.description: A calibration board lying on the ground: centre x, y (metres), yaw (degrees).

rig_part.description: Centre x, y, z (metres) in the vehicle frame; box: length along x and width along y before yaw; cylinder: vertical; bar: horizontal along y before yaw.

ecu.description: The computer the cameras connect to, for cable routing and the link budget.

route_factor.description: Routing slack over the Manhattan length.

link_gbps.description: GMSL2 forward channel per camera link.

bpp.description: Bits per pixel the ECU receives (16 = YUV 4:2:2).

photos.description: Reference photos of the vehicle fitted to the body (landmarks, camera poses of the photos).

source.description: Folder or .zip of the photos on the computer that fitted them.

fleet.description: Vehicles built to this design and their measured calibrations (core.fleet).

records.description: Measured poses of some sensors on one date (vehicle frame, metres and degrees).
